text:
julia: Quick design review — putting the thread here for API key management panel. Snapshot attached in figma link (see comments). Main asks: 1) inline warning copy for revoke/rotate, 2) button hierarchy in the key detail slide-over, 3) empty state microcopy and CTA prominence, 4) contrast + aria for the 'show secret' toggle. TL;DR: a few accessibility nits and copy tweaks.

mike: looks good overall. one thing: current slide-over has primary action as `Rotate key` and danger as `Revoke`. Are we set on rotate being primary? ops often want revoke more visible.

julia: good point — we made rotate primary because rotate is reversible (you can issue new key) and we want to nudge safe flows, but revoke should be visually distinct. maybe make rotate primary, revoke a red text button but not the full primary.

aisha: agree with julia's intent. also, the permissions badge (Admin / Read / Embed-only) needs clearer affordance — customers confused whether rotation preserves scopes. Can we add a one-line hint: "Rotation preserves scopes"?

mike: adding that hint sounds fine. implementation note: rotation keeps scopes in backend; we'll expose that string.

dan: accessibility nits: 1) the `Show secret` icon button has <button aria-label="Show secret"> but the visible label is empty — need keyboard focus outline and announcer text. 2) color contrast on the small grey hint under the key name is failing AA for 12px.

julia: thanks dan. proposals: change aria-label to `Show API secret, reveals sensitive key` and make hint text use 14px token color-strong. Also add a visually-hidden element announcing `API secret revealed` for screenreaders when toggled.

mike: FYI keyboard behavior: we currently set the secret field to `type="password"` and toggle to `text`. screenreader announcement is doable via `aria-live="polite"` region. example snippet: ```html
<button aria-controls="secret-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Show API secret, reveals sensitive key">👁️</button>
<input id="secret-1" type="password" aria-live="polite" />
```

julia: perfect — use `aria-live` and update the label string. also re: revoke confirmation modal copy: current says "Are you sure?" Too generic. Suggest: "Revoking this key will immediately block all services using it. This cannot be undone." and primary action `Cancel`, danger `Revoke key`.

aisha: +1. can we add an inline checklist in the modal: "Affected services: N/A (run a dependency scan)" maybe link to a runbook. Small link below modal: "Run dependency scan" that opens a modal step.

dan: modal needs focus trap and a clear escape path for keyboard-only users. also ensure the revoke button has `aria-describedby` referencing the consequence text.

julia: noted. layout question: on the keys list empty state, currently the CTA says `Create your first key`. someone suggested `Add API key` — which is more discoverable?

mike: `Create your first key` is friendlier for new users. `Add API key` reads like a product-ops action.

aisha: data point: our signup funnel shows many users call it "create" in tooltips. let's keep `Create your first key` for empty state and `Add` on the list actions for power users.

dan: empty state accessibility: ensure the illustration has empty `alt=""` and the heading is H2 not H1 when on a dashboard. Also ensure the CTA has focus visible outline.

julia: copy tweak for the empty state subtext: current draft "Keys let your apps call Redwood." propose "API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely." Slightly more explicit.

mike: sounds good. small request: for the key row affordances, make the copy-to-clipboard button use `aria-label="Copy secret to clipboard"` and show a toast with `Copied API key` that is `role="status"` so screenreaders announce it.

dan: +1. toasts need `aria-live="assertive"` or `polite` depending on severity; `Copied` should be `polite`.

julia: last UX nit — when rotating keys, we show a temporary secret that can be copied only once. need clearer microcopy: "This is the new secret. You will not be able to see it again. Copy now."

aisha: yes, legal/reg team asked to add "Ensure this secret is stored in a secrets manager. Redwood will not retain this value."

mike: implemented server-side; we'll add the text. question: do we provide a download `.env` file? could be handy.

julia: maybe as an optional link: `Download .env` next to `Copy` with a tiny disclosure icon. default should be copy only.

dan: ensure the downloaded file has minimal metadata and is named `redwood-api-key.env` with mode 0600 on the server side if we ever persist — but probably client-only blob download.

aisha: action items: julia to update figma with revised modal copy and empty state copy; mike to implement aria-live and copy toast behavior; dan to run quick accessibility pass on the new components. I'll follow up with proposed wording by EOD.

julia: noted — I'll update figma and paste new copy here once done. thanks all :sparkles:
